name: shaderlab-kit
description: Unity HLSL/URP shader tooling for VS Code: completion, hover docs, diagnostics, formatting, go-to-definition, snippets, and an experimental 3D material preview.

shaderlabKit.suggest.enable.description: Enable IntelliSense completion for HLSL intrinsics, semantics, and Unity/URP built-ins.

shaderlabKit.analysis.enable.description: Enable diagnostics and semantic analysis for ShaderLab/HLSL files.

shaderlabKit.analysis.maxVariantsWarning.description: Warn when a shader's multi_compile/shader_feature combinations exceed this count.

shaderlabKit.analysis.maxVariantsError.description: Report an error when a shader's multi_compile/shader_feature combinations exceed this count.

shaderlabKit.formatting.enable.description: Enable document formatting for ShaderLab/HLSL files.

shaderlabKit.formatting.bracestyle.description: Enforce consistent brace placement when formatting.

shaderlabKit.formatting.tags.singleline.description: Keep single Tags { "Key"="Value" } entries on one line when formatting.

shaderlabKit.formatting.cbuffer.description: Apply consistent indentation inside cbuffer/CBUFFER blocks when formatting.

enumDescriptions: Directives follow the surrounding code; code inside #if blocks is indented one level deeper per nesting level.
Directives follow the surrounding code; code inside #if blocks gets no extra indent.
Directives are placed at column 0; code inside #if blocks gets no extra indent.
Directive lines are left untouched; code inside #if blocks gets no extra indent.
shaderlabKit.formatting.preprocessorStyl.description: How preprocessor directives (#if/#define/etc.) and the code inside #if blocks are indented when formatting.

shaderlabKit.formatting.indentIncludeGua.description: Treat a header include guard (#ifndef X followed by #define X) as an indentation level. Off by default: the guarded contents stay flush.

shaderlabKit.include.enable.description: Enable #include resolution (Unity project, Package Manager, and custom paths) for go-to-definition and hover.

shaderlabKit.include.customPaths.description: Additional search paths (absolute or workspace-relative) to resolve #include directives against.

shaderlabKit.preview.refreshDelay.description: (Experimental) Milliseconds to wait after the last edit before the shader preview refreshes. Saving refreshes immediately.

shaderlabKit.include.unityEditorPathOver.description: Explicit path to the Unity Editor installation, used to resolve built-in includes when auto-detection fails (e.g. Unity not installed locally, CI environments).

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
